frames.title: Lesson 131 · Integrated communication: Philosophy — Plato’s cave

body: **Foco:** Comunicação integrada: Filosofia.
**Pronúncia:** Ajuste refinado de entonação.
**24 palavras novas** (filosofia).
**Texto do dia:** transcrição de palestra e podcast.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre a alegoria da caverna a partir da transcrição de um podcast, explicando metáforas filosóficas com entonação variada.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Podcast: “The Cave, Revisited”
paras: HOST: In Book VII of the *Republic*, Plato asks us to **imagine** prisoners **chained** in a cave since childhood, facing a wall. Behind them a fire burns, and **shadows** of objects **dance** on the stone. For the prisoners, **those shadows are reality**.

GUEST: **What matters** is what happens next. One prisoner is **freed** and **dragged** into the sunlight. At first he is **blinded**; **only gradually** does he **come to see** the real world, **and, eventually, the sun itself**.

GUEST: **He is mocked**. The others **cannot be persuaded** that the shadows are mere images. **Plato’s point** is that **education** is not filling an empty vessel; it is **turning the whole soul** toward the light.

items.q: The prisoners know the shadows are only images.
The freed prisoner is blinded at first.
Plato sees education as filling an empty vessel.

opts: chegar a enxergar, passar a entender

rows: **Only gradually does** he come to see…

blocks.body: Contando uma **alegoria**, use o **presente histórico** e **passiva**. Advérbios restritivos (*only gradually*) pedem **inversão**.
Alegoria ≠ fato histórico: diga *Plato asks us to imagine…*, não *there was a cave*.

items.s: Plato asks us to ___ prisoners chained in a cave. (imagine)
One prisoner ___ freed and dragged into the sunlight. (be, presente)
Only gradually ___ he come to see the real world. (do)
He is ___ by the others. (mock, particípio)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: What happens when one is freed
items.pt: O que acontece quando um é libertado?

items.ans: So the shadows are all they know
items.pt: Então as sombras são tudo que conhecem?

body: **See the light** — ver a luz, entender
**In the dark** — no escuro
**Cast a shadow over** — lançar sombra sobre
**Shed light on** — esclarecer
**Face the facts** — encarar os fatos
**Lift the veil** — levantar o véu
**Out of the shadows** — sair das sombras
**Blind to** — cego para
**Open one’s eyes to** — abrir os olhos para
**Take at face value** — levar ao pé da letra
**So the shadows are all they know?** — Então as sombras são tudo que conhecem?
**Yes, and they take them for reality.** — Sim, e as tomam pela realidade.
**What happens when one is freed?** — O que acontece quando um é libertado?

prompts.model: Only gradually does he come to see.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence retelling of Plato’s cave in your own words, in the present tense.
blocks.model: Imagine prisoners chained in a cave, facing a wall. Shadows dance on the stone, and the prisoners take them for reality. One of them is freed and dragged into the sunlight. Only gradually does he come to see the real world. When he returns, he is mocked. Plato’s point is that education turns the whole soul toward the light.

items.q: What does “allegory of the cave” mean?
items.why: **allegory of the cave** = alegoria da caverna.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
